name: typography
description: Research-grounded typography for any text-bearing surface — web, PDF, email, documents. GENERATIVE: apply correct line length, font sizing, contrast, dark mode, mobile, and Japanese rules from the start when building any UI, page, layout, or document. REVIEW: audit existing CSS/HTML/templates for typography violations. Use this skill whenever you are writing CSS that touches font-size, line-height, max-width, color, or font-family. Use it when building any frontend component, page, or layout — even if the user doesn't mention typography. Use it when reviewing any rendered output for readability. Use it when generating PDFs, emails, or any formatted document. If text will be read by a human, this skill applies.
